name: BACH_0004
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (70%)** · Ambiguous: Normal vs InSitu · Careful review
Invasive probability is near 0%, but Normal is in the conformal set and no similar case is InSitu.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 70%, Normal 17%, Benign 14%, Invasive 0% | Clear lead, not decisive |
| Conformal set | Normal, InSitu (90% level) | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.95 / 94th percentile | Not flagged; high OOD percentile |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model agrees |
| Similar cases | 0 of 5 InSitu; all Normal | Neighbors disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (regions 1, 3, 6) · context · TIL score above typical; descriptive only · Weak
- **Normal lobules, two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 4, 10) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; concept model links it to lower invasive likelihood · Unreliable
- **Frequent mitoses** (regions 2, 5, 7) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical score; failed spot check, 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Low score here; lowers concept model's invasive estimate · Validated
- **Neoplastic nuclei fraction** (regions 0, 7, 8) · context · 52% of sampled nuclei; 88th reference percentile · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cut the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI spans 0 (−0.005 to 0.007), so not shown to reflect the classifier; mitoses and normal lobules are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Normal is the true class: all 5 neighbors are Normal, and Normal is in the conformal set.
- Neoplastic counts come from only three sampled regions.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 7, 8** — Confirm neoplastic cells stay within ducts, with no stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 0, 4, 10** — Verify the lobules are truly normal; this concept failed its spot check (0/20).
3. **Regions 2, 5, 7** — Look for genuine mitoses; the mitosis concept scored 0/20.
